001: Good afternoon, professor. Do you have a moment to talk?
Of course, Laura. Come in and have a seat. How can I help you?
It's about the midterm exam. I didn't understand some topics very well.
Very well. Tell me which part you found most difficult.
Especially the grammar exercises from the third unit.
Ah, okay. We can go over them right now if you want.
002: Excuse me, could you review my work before I turn it in?
Of course, let me see it. Which part worries you the most?
I'm not sure if the conclusion is well developed.
The idea is good, but you can expand it a little more.
Would you recommend a book to improve my writing?
I recommend one on academic style that I have right here.
003: Professor, I have a question about the office hours schedule.
Sure, tell me. On Tuesdays and Thursdays in the afternoon I'm free.
Could I come on Thursday at four?
Yes, perfect. I'll write down your name so I don't forget.
Thank you very much. Then I'll see you on Thursday.
All right, see you then. Bring your notes.
004: I couldn't attend Monday's class, could you explain the topic to me?
Of course. We covered the difference between ser and estar.
I see. Could you lend me the notes from that day?
Yes, I have a copy right here. I'll lend them to you, no problem.
I really appreciate it. I'll bring them back next week.
No rush. Take care of them and review the examples well.
005: I'd like to talk to you about my grade on the essay.
Sure, Marta. Tell me, what is it you don't understand?
I don't understand why you gave me a six when I followed the instructions.
The structure was correct, but the analysis needed to be deeper.
I understand. What could I do to improve the grade?
You can expand the theoretical part and turn it in again.
006: Professor, do you have any advice for preparing the oral presentation?
Yes, I recommend practicing out loud several times.
And what do I do if I get really nervous when speaking?
Take a deep breath and remember that the audience isn't going to judge you.
Thanks, that calms me down quite a bit.
Also, prepare a short outline with the main ideas.
007: Would you mind explaining the exercise on the board to me again?
Not at all. Which part wasn't clear to you?
The use of the subjunctive after certain expressions.
Okay, I'll explain it to you with other, simpler examples.
Now I understand it much better. Thank you so much.
I'm glad. Any other questions, don't hesitate to come by.
008: I wanted to let you know that I'm going to be absent next week.
Understood. Is it for an important reason?
Yes, I have to travel because of a family emergency.
I'm sorry. I hope everything gets resolved soon.
Thanks. Could you tell me what topics you're going to cover?
Sure, I'll give you the reading list so you can get ahead.
009: Professor, do you think my Spanish level has improved?
Yes, there's noticeable progress since the beginning of the course.
What aspects should I work on more?
Especially your fluency when speaking and your vocabulary.
Do you recommend any activity to practice?
I suggest watching series in Spanish with subtitles.
010: Hello, I've come to pick up the corrections for my exam.
Hi, Sofía. Yes, I have them right here ready.
I see that I failed the reading comprehension questions.
Don't worry, that's normal. Let's look at the mistakes together.
Do you think I can improve for the next exam?
Of course, with daily practice and consistency you'll get there.
